Sales Engineer

Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
Department: Sales Engineering

About Druva: 
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

 Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

 Position Summary 
Druva is seeking to hire a Sales Engineer with a focus on Data Protection with AI &amp;Data Security. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide technical direction and business guidance to the regional sales teams. We are looking for a motivated and proactive
individual to help exceed sales targets by driving innovative technical programs, conducting customer demonstrations, POCs, and overseeing daily technical solutioning activities. You will be responsible for evangelizing, positioning, and
architecting Druva’s Data Protection, AI &amp; Data Security Solutions to a mix of new &amp; existing customer accounts in the region.

 Key Responsibilities 
• Demonstrates technical leadership and subject matter expertise on fully managed cloud-native SaaS, Endpoint &amp; Server Data Protection, AI &amp; Data Security, and Cyber Resiliency

 • Provides technical leadership and direction to customers and internal staff in the development of Druva solutions, supporting pre-sales activities within the assigned region

 • Leverage technical discovery and qualification fundamentals to establish rapport as a trusted advisor to develop and propose solutions that meet the technology and business requirements of prospective &amp; existing customer accounts in the region

 • Meet business objectives by collaborating with Sales Executives in the region
• Assist in delivering technical enablement to the Druva Channel Partner ecosystem

 Requirements 

• 5 to 8 years in technical customer-facing roles with at least 2+ years as a sales engineer working with enterprise software solutions

 • Intermediate-level knowledge of enterprise server backup technologies
• Intermediate-level knowledge of Virtualization Platforms VMWare, HyperV, Nutanix &amp; ProxMox.

 • Intermediate-level knowledge of Databases such as MS-SQL, Oracle, Azure SQL.
• Working knowledge &amp; understanding of AI concepts and tools. Hands on knowledge of Claude, Copilot would be added advantage.
• Intermediate level knowledge of operating systems, including MS Windows, Linux,& amp; macOS.
• Experience with Active Directory, Entra ID, SSO, MFA, SCCM, and automated deployment tools.

 • Intermediate level of knowledge of industry AI.
• Basic understanding of network technologies and protocols – TCP/IP, VLAN, DNS, switches, firewalls, routers, and proxies

 • Entrepreneurial - willing to go the extra mile, strong work ethic, resourceful, “get it
done” attitude

 • A highly energetic drive to meet goals with a strong hands-on, “can-do” approach

responsibilities: AI-First SDLC & Shift-Left Automation: Architect and embed AI-driven security controls (SAST, DAST, SCA, Container, Secrets Detection) directly into CI/CD build pipelines and developer workflows, establishing an intelligent, highly automated AI-first SDLC.
Operational & Strategic AI Security: Leverage AI tooling operationally (e.g., auto-triage, threat-model drafting, fix generation) while strategizing security controls for product-facing AI features.

AI & Emerging Tech Threat Modeling: Assess risks specific to Generative and Agentic AI architectures, including MCP integrations, autonomous agents, tool-calling interfaces, multi-agent communication, prompt injections, and memory/context poisoning (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / Agentic Apps).
Developer Guidance & Vulnerability Remediation: Review code (Python, Go, Javascript, etc), triage findings, and partner with engineering to implement robust short and long-term security fixes.
Supply Chain & Software Integrity: Manage third-party open-source risks, open-source dependency tracking, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), and secure MCP/agent server ecosystems.
Enablement & Champions Program: Conduct secure coding workshops, train developers on secure AI usage, and help grow an active Security Champions network.
AppSec Fundamentals: Deep expertise in OWASP Top 10, CWE 25, threat modeling, cryptography, container security, and secure SDLC frameworks (SAMM, Microsoft SDL).

AI Security & AI-First SDLC Expertise: Strong hands-on expertise with AI-first SDLC methodologies and reviewing AI security risks specifically around Agentic AI systems, MCP security (authorization, tool poisoning, confused deputy risks), and LLM security controls.
requiredQualifications: Experience: 6–10 years of product security engineering experience in a SaaS environment, with a proven track record of technical leadership.
Operational AI Use-Cases: Experience using AI tools to optimize security engineering workflows (e.g., automating root-cause analysis, threat modeling assistance, automated policy generation).

Programming & Tooling: Proficient in code review and scripting with Python, Go, or Javascript (hands-on development experience is a major plus). Hands-on with tools like Burp Suite, Snyk, OWASP ZAP, and CI/CD security scanners.

Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in CS/IT or equivalent. Relevant certifications (OSCP, OSWE, CSSLP, GIAC) or active community contributions (OWASP, BSides, NullCon, Black Hat, etc) are a plus.
